# ERRORS

The closed public diagnostic registry (SPEC.md §26). Every user-visible
failure carries exactly one of these codes, emitted through a checked
constructor whose argument is a compile-time literal; `validate-model`
rejects an unregistered code in use and an unused registered code.

`lexlean explain <CODE>` prints one entry.

## `LLB6005` --- Target realization program or Rust package invalid or unrenderable

A production-realization target program is malformed, violates the calculus's static rules, or cannot be rendered faithfully to the Rust profile, or a Rust package manifest is malformed or misstates its crate name, version, sources, exports, or the interface of the program it packages.

Class: `language`. Exit code: 1.

## `LLB6006` --- GNAF request malformed

A GNAF request is not a closed `lexlean/gnaf-request/1` document, its reference program or a system its universe realizes is not a valid target program, its reference returns no value on a domain argument, its grammar repeats a threshold or misdeclares a plan's preparation, or its stated universe identity is not the one its components determine.

Class: `language`. Exit code: 1.

## `LLG1001` --- Lexeme source not canonicalizable

A lexeme source is not a lexable Lean token stream, or two of its declarations have the same fully qualified name.

Class: `language`. Exit code: 1.

## `LLG1002` --- Lexeme entry schema or canonical-form failure

A lexeme entry is not a valid `lexlean/lexeme/1` document, its declared digest is not the digest of its own canonical form, or its fields are not canonically ordered.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1003` --- Signature invalid or key unusable

A detached Ed25519 signature is not 64 bytes, its public key is not a valid Ed25519 public key, or the signature does not verify under the public key the entry records.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1004` --- Signing key or hardware token unavailable

The requested signing key is bound to a hardware device that is absent, does not answer, or did not accept the PIN, and a software fallback is not permitted.

Class: `environment`. Exit code: 3.

## `LLG1005` --- RFC 3161 timestamp token invalid

An RFC 3161 timestamp response is not a well-formed `TimeStampResp`, its token does not carry `id-ct-TSTInfo`, its message imprint names another algorithm, another digest, or another artifact, or its `genTime` is not a valid UTC instant.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1006` --- Timestamp certificate chain untrusted

A timestamp token's signature does not verify under the certificate the entry carries, that certificate does not verify under the pinned TSA root the entry carries, or the root's validity interval does not contain the token's `genTime`.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1007` --- Merkle inclusion proof invalid

An inclusion proof does not recompute the published root from the entry's leaf hash, its audit path has the wrong length for the tree size, or its leaf index is not below the tree size.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1008` --- Consistency proof invalid

Two published tree heads are not consistent, because the consistency proof from the smaller size does not recompute the larger root from the smaller root, or because the smaller size exceeds the larger.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1009` --- Ledger storage or publication failure

A ledger directory is unreadable, its stored tree head does not equal the root recomputed from its own entries, an entry could not be published atomically, or a tree head is not signed by the log key.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1010` --- Timestamp verification provider unavailable

The RFC 3161 signature verifier could not be reached, would not start, or exceeded a child limit, so the timestamp is unestablished rather than disproved; no weaker check is substituted.

Class: `environment`. Exit code: 3.

## `LLG1011` --- Lexeme is not a prime-indexed stratum

A lexeme has no declarations, so it is not a stratum, or the prime index recorded for it is not the least prime not below its atom count.

Class: `language`. Exit code: 1.

## `LLG1012` --- Contractivity anchor names an absent declaration

A contractivity receipt's theorem anchor names a declaration that is not an atom of the lexeme's stratum, which the receipt cannot certify.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1013` --- Contractivity receipt malformed

A contractivity receipt carries a rational that is not reduced, a negative numerator or non-positive denominator, a status its norm does not imply, or a receipt hash that is not the digest of its own frames.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1014` --- Contractivity norm not below one

The exact rational one-norm of the reference graph is not below one, so the receipt is refused and states the reduced value that failed.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLG1015` --- Zeno-Finton gain offered as a time anchor

A Zeno-Finton gain was offered to satisfy a §33.4 timestamp check or to appear in a verdict; the gain is supplementary and an external RFC 3161 token is the only time anchor.

Class: `cli-configuration`. Exit code: 2.

## `LLV7011` --- Named-root extraction rejected
